guidance.outcomeQualityDetail: ACCT is the accuracy numerator. IMP and QNC are excluded from the denominator, not counted as accurate. A high accuracy rate indicates FAQ content is precise.
guidance.focusAreasDetail: ERR, NEW, CUST, and OOS drive escalation. Review these categories for knowledge base gaps.
guidance.naShareDetail: NA sessions are excluded from rate calculations. High NA share may indicate unclassified or non-FAQ traffic.

codeDef.ACCT: Content accurate — FAQ content is complete and clear, accurately addressing the user's question with no modifications needed.
codeDef.IMP: Needs improvement — FAQ content is usable but could be clearer or better structured. Improvement recommended.
codeDef.ERR: Error to fix — FAQ contains incorrect or misleading information that must be corrected promptly.
codeDef.NEW: New question — User raised a question not covered by existing FAQs. Recommend adding as new FAQ.
codeDef.QNC: Question not clear — User's question is vague or ambiguous; existing FAQs cannot accurately respond.
codeDef.CUST: Customised request — User's question is too individual to be addressed by a general FAQ; requires manual handling.
codeDef.OOS: Out of scope — User's question falls outside the supported scope and cannot be handled by existing resources.
codeDef.NA: Non-AI reply — Scripted/fixed response, not generated by an AI model. Not subject to FAQ quality evaluation.
codeDef.HES: Human escalation selected (legacy) — User explicitly clicked to transfer to a human agent. Classified as NA.
codeDef.NA-HES: OHLA handoff — User clicked to transfer to a human agent via OHLA. Classified as NA.

catDef.KB_GAP: Knowledge base gap — The chatbot had no accurate answer because KB/FAQ content is missing or outdated for this topic.
catDef.USER_HABIT: User habit — User bypassed self-service and contacted human support directly by habit, even though an FAQ answer exists.
catDef.AGENT_ERR: Agent error — The SSC chatbot gave an incorrect or misleading answer, causing the user to escalate.
catDef.MANUAL_SSC: Manual SSC handling — Issue requires case-specific human judgment (account actions, approvals, login issues, edge cases).
catDef.ONSITE: Onsite required — Requires physical onsite support (hardware swap, cabling, desk setup, physical access).
catDef.SECURITY: Security escalation — Security-related ticket (phishing tests, policy violations, threat reports, suspicious activity).
catDef.MONITORING: Monitoring alert — Auto-generated ticket from monitoring systems (Grafana alerts, automated triggers, system health checks).
catDef.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Out of scope — Issue falls entirely outside OIT support scope; belongs to another team or vendor.
catDef.UNCLASSIFIED: Unclassified — Incident has not yet been assigned an AI category.
